ModMetaData.name: Jawa Doctrine Patches
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Campaign-doctrine patches: small, surgical changes that enforce the Jawa design rules rather than rebalancing numbers.
Currently: removes the Droid Factory from the build menu. Droid parts, repair and upgrading are deliberately untouched. The Jawa restore droids; they do not manufacture them.
Rationale lives in worldbuilding/balance_paradigm.md (Axis 18a/18b). Load last.
